evidence: The AI203 films were deposited on 5 × 5 cm ~ soda lime glass substrates at 500 °C using AICI3 (99.9%, Aldrich) and distilled water as precursors. AICI3 was evaporated from an open boat held at 90 °C inside the reactor and pulsed onto the substrates by means of inert gas valving. Water vapor, generated in an external reservoir held at 20 °C, was led into the reactor through needle and solenoid valves. The pulse and purge times were 0.2 and 0.5 s, respectively. The number of deposition cycles was varied between 0 and 20 000.
